issues.message: multi-node MPI on standard (e2 nodes, standard networking, any zone): fine for loosely coupled work; tightly coupled codes (GROMACS, LAMMPS, CFD) scale better on computehigh (Tier_1 networking, fast cores)

-march=native compiles for AVX-512 or for the build host (-march=native), but standard nodes (e2) have AVX2 only: the program can die with 'Illegal instruction'. Use -march=x86-64-v3 (what the site software uses), or run on computehigh (Intel, AVX-512)

data.note: Static check only; nothing was submitted. standard gives whole nodes, so cost is per node regardless of cores used.
